items.title: The Integrin Signature of Ankylosing Spondylitis: Divergent Regulation of CD29 and CD49b in HLA-B27-Positive Cohorts in Iraqi Patients.
items.abstract: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is a systemic inflammatory disorder where the HLA-B27 allele significantly influences disease severity. This study evaluated the molecular profiles of integrins CD29 and CD49b in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) to identify potential biomarkers associated with HLA-B27 status. In this cross-sectional study of an Iraqi cohort, 130 participants were recruited: 50 HLA-B27-positive (HLA+) radiographic AS patients, 50 HLA-B27-negative (HLA-) radiographic AS patients, and 30 healthy controls. Transcriptomic and proteomic expressions of CD29 and CD49b were quantified using qPCR and flow cytometry (mean fluorescence intensity, MFI). Hematological and biochemical profiles were also assessed. CD29 mRNA was significantly upregulated in both patient groups, with a more pronounced median elevation in the HLA+ group (11-fold; P < 0.0001) than in the HLA- group (3-fold; P < 0.001). Surface CD29 protein significantly increased only in the HLA+ cohort (mean MFI approximately 3000; P < 0.0001). Conversely, CD49b mRNA was substantially suppressed, particularly in the HLA+ group (P < 0.0001). Correspondingly, a marked reduction in CD49b surface protein occurred in the HLA+ cohort (mean MFI approximately 300; P < 0.0001), whereas the HLA- group remained statistically comparable to controls. Additionally, the HLA- phenotype was characterized by significant granulocytosis (85%-90%) and more pronounced elevations in urea and ALT levels. These findings suggest a divergent regulation of CD29 and CD49b integrins associated with HLA-B27 status in Iraqi AS patients. While these integrins may serve as molecular indicators for disease stratification, longitudinal validation is required to confirm their clinical utility as diagnostic or therapeutic targets.

items.title: Early-life dietary patterns and the risk of juvenile-onset ankylosing spondylitis: a nationwide cohort study in South Korea.
items.abstract: Emerging evidence suggests that early-life exposures may influence the development of inflammatory joint diseases. This study investigated the association between early-life exposures and the incidence of juvenile-onset ankylosing spondylitis (JAS) in a nationwide South Korean cohort. This study included 1,242,257 infants from the South Korean National Health Insurance Service. The association between early-life exposures-such as food diversity, frequency of solid food intake, antibiotic use, and breastfeeding status-and the development of JAS, was examined. Food diversity and frequency of solid food intake were assessed at the 9-12 month screening visit, breastfeeding status was assessed at the 4-6 month and 9-12 month screening visit, and antibiotic use was based on prescription records within the first year after birth. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to food diversity levels. Adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using Cox proportional hazards models. Food diversity and breastfeeding alone were not associated with JAS. However, breastfeeding in infants with high food diversity was linked to a reduced risk of JAS. (aHR 0.53, 95% CI 0.31-0.90, p = 0.0195). Pediatrics with high food diversity who were breastfed showed reduced vulnerability to JAS. These findings suggest that maintaining a consistent and appropriate dietary pattern may play an important role in the prevention of JAS.

items.titleZh: 早期饮食模式与青少年发病性强直性脊柱炎风险：韩国全国性队列研究
items.abstractZh: 新出现的证据表明，早期生活暴露可能影响炎症性关节疾病的发生。本研究在韩国全国性队列中调查了早期生活暴露与青少年发病性强直性脊柱炎（JAS）发病率之间的关联。本研究纳入了来自韩国国民健康保险服务的1,242,257名婴儿。研究考察了早期生活暴露（如食物多样性、固体食物摄入频率、抗生素使用和母乳喂养状况）与JAS发生之间的关联。食物多样性和固体食物摄入频率在9-12个月筛查访视时评估，母乳喂养状况在4-6个月和9-12个月筛查访视时评估，抗生素使用基于出生后第一年内的处方记录。根据食物多样性水平进行了亚组分析。使用Cox比例风险模型计算调整后风险比（aHR）和95%置信区间（CI）。食物多样性和单独母乳喂养与JAS无关联。然而，在食物多样性高的婴儿中，母乳喂养与JAS风险降低相关（aHR 0.53，95% CI 0.31-0.90，p = 0.0195）。食物多样性高且接受母乳喂养的儿童对JAS的易感性降低。这些发现表明，保持一致且适当的饮食模式可能在预防JAS中发挥重要作用。

items.title: Clustering of rheumatoid arthritis patients: an unsupervised machine learning approach for characterizing the TNFi response.
items.abstract: This study aimed to identifydistinct profiles of response to Tumor Necrosis Factor inhibitors (TNFi) in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) patients using unsupervised machine learning to integrate clinical, demographic, and genetic data. A cohort of 294 RA patients was analyzed using hierarchical clustering techniques. Data collected included body mass index (BMI), adherence to physical activity, prevalence of comorbidities, seropositivity, Health Assessment Questionnaire (HAQ) scores, and genetic polymorphisms in TNF pathway. Responders to TNFi demonstrated a more favorable clinical profile, with a lower BMI (25.6 vs. 27.0; p = 0.03), higher physical activity adherence (56.6% vs. 33.3%; p < 0.01), reduced prevalence of comorbidities (69.8% vs. 82.4%; p = 0.02), and improved functionality (HAQ: 0.8 vs. 1.7; p < 0.01) compared with non-responders. The C allele of rs767455 was significantly more frequent among responders (74.4% vs. 62.4%; p = 0.04). Clustering analysis identified three distinct subgroups: a better prognosis group characterized by a 73.5% response rate, minimal use of combination therapies, high adherence to physical activity, and male predominance; a poorer therapeutic response group with 82.9% therapeutic failure, intensive medication use, and low exercise adherence; and an intermediate group. TNFi response in RA is multifactorial. Integrating clinical, demographic, and genetic data enables the identification of distinct patient profiles, supporting the development of personalized treatment strategies and the advancement of precision medicine in RA management.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎患者的聚类分析：一种用于表征TNFi反应的无监督机器学习方法
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在使用无监督机器学习整合临床、人口统计学和遗传数据，识别类风湿关节炎（RA）患者对肿瘤坏死因子抑制剂（TNFi）反应的不同特征。采用层次聚类技术分析了294例RA患者的队列。收集的数据包括体重指数（BMI）、体力活动依从性、合并症患病率、血清阳性、健康评估问卷（HAQ）评分以及TNF通路中的遗传多态性。与无反应者相比，TNFi反应者表现出更有利的临床特征，BMI较低（25.6 vs. 27.0；p = 0.03），体力活动依从性较高（56.6% vs. 33.3%；p < 0.01），合并症患病率降低（69.8% vs. 82.4%；p = 0.02），功能改善（HAQ：0.8 vs. 1.7；p < 0.01）。rs767455的C等位基因在反应者中显著更常见（74.4% vs. 62.4%；p = 0.04）。聚类分析识别出三个不同的亚组：一个预后较好的组，其特征为反应率73.5%，联合治疗使用最少，体力活动依从性高，且以男性为主；一个治疗反应较差的组，治疗失败率为82.9%，药物使用密集，运动依从性低；以及一个中间组。RA中的TNFi反应是多因素的。整合临床、人口统计学和遗传数据能够识别不同的患者特征，支持个体化治疗策略的制定和RA管理中精准医学的推进。

items.title: Association of hematological inflammatory indices with disease activity and interstitial lung disease in systemic sclerosis.
items.abstract: The current study evaluates the association of hematological inflammatory indices with disease activity and interstitial lung disease (ILD) in patients with systemic sclerosis (SSc), with particular emphasis on their potential independent predictive value for pulmonary involvement. This cross-sectional study included 51 patients diagnosed with SSc and 106 healthy controls. Hematological parameters, including neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), red cell distribution width (RDW), and mean platelet volume (MPV), were compared between groups. Disease activity was assessed using the European Scleroderma Trials and Research (EUSTAR) activity index, and patients were further evaluated according to the presence of ILD. Multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify independent predictors of ILD. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis was used to assess the discriminatory performance of hematological inflammatory indices. Compared with healthy controls, patients with SSc had significantly higher levels of NLR, PLR, SII, RDW, C-reactive protein (CRP), and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), while MPV was significantly lower (p < 0.05 for all). Patients with active disease (EUSTAR ≥ 2.5) demonstrated significantly higher modified Rodnan skin score (mRSS), NLR, and SII levels compared with patients with inactive disease (p < 0.05). In analyses according to ILD status, both NLR and SII were significantly elevated in patients with ILD, whereas PLR, RDW, MPV, CRP, and ESR did not differ significantly between groups (p > 0.05). Anti-Scl-70 positivity was significantly more frequent in patients with ILD, while anti-centromere positivity was more common in patients without ILD. ROC analysis demonstrated moderate discriminatory performance for SII (AUC = 0.72) and NLR (AUC = 0.68). In multivariable logistic regression analysis, anti-Scl-70 positivity emerged as the strongest independent predictor of ILD, while NLR remained independently associated with ILD (OR 2.63, 95% CI 1.01-6.85, p = 0.047). SII did not retain statistical significance in the multivariable model. Hematological inflammatory indices are associated with disease activity and pulmonary involvement in SSc. Among these indices, NLR appears to be a more robust independent marker of ILD compared to SII. These findings suggest that simple hematological indices may provide additional value in the clinical assessment of patients with SSc. Key Points • Patients with SSc-associated ILD exhibited significantly higher NLR and SII levels than those without ILD. • NLR remained independently associated with ILD after adjustment for established clinical and serological factors. • NLR and SII were associated with both pulmonary involvement and disease activity, supporting their potential utility as readily available inflammatory biomarkers in SSc.

items.titleZh: 血液炎症指标与系统性硬化症疾病活动度及间质性肺病的关联
items.abstractZh: 本研究评估了血液炎症指标与系统性硬化症（SSc）患者疾病活动度及间质性肺病（ILD）的关联，特别关注其对肺部受累的潜在独立预测价值。这项横断面研究纳入了51例确诊为SSc的患者和106例健康对照。比较了两组间的血液学参数，包括中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值（NLR）、血小板与淋巴细胞比值（PLR）、系统性免疫炎症指数（SII）、红细胞分布宽度（RDW）和平均血小板体积（MPV）。使用欧洲硬皮病试验与研究（EUSTAR）活动指数评估疾病活动度，并根据是否存在ILD对患者进行进一步评估。进行多变量逻辑回归分析以确定ILD的独立预测因子。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估血液炎症指标的区分性能。与健康对照相比，SSc患者的NLR、PLR、SII、RDW、C反应蛋白（CRP）和红细胞沉降率（ESR）水平显著升高，而MPV显著降低（所有p < 0.05）。活动期疾病（EUSTAR ≥ 2.5）患者与非活动期疾病患者相比，改良Rodnan皮肤评分（mRSS）、NLR和SII水平显著升高（p < 0.05）。根据ILD状态进行的分析中，NLR和SII在ILD患者中均显著升高，而PLR、RDW、MPV、CRP和ESR在两组间无显著差异（p > 0.05）。抗Scl-70阳性在ILD患者中显著更常见，而抗着丝点阳性在无ILD患者中更常见。ROC分析显示SII（AUC = 0.72）和NLR（AUC = 0.68）具有中等区分性能。在多变量逻辑回归分析中，抗Scl-70阳性成为ILD的最强独立预测因子，而NLR仍与ILD独立相关（OR 2.63，95% CI 1.01-6.85，p = 0.047）。SII在多变量模型中未保持统计学显著性。血液炎症指标与SSc的疾病活动度和肺部受累相关。在这些指标中，与SII相比，NLR似乎是ILD更稳健的独立标志物。这些发现表明，简单的血液学指标可能为SSc患者的临床评估提供额外价值。要点 • 伴有SSc相关ILD的患者NLR和SII水平显著高于无ILD患者。 • 在调整已确定的临床和血清学因素后，NLR仍与ILD独立相关。 • NLR和SII与肺部受累和疾病活动度均相关，支持其作为SSc中易于获得的炎症生物标志物的潜在效用。

items.title: Facial cosmetic therapy use amongst patients with systemic sclerosis: an Australian cohort study.
items.abstract: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is associated with numerous facial manifestations for which patients may engage in cosmetic therapies. It is unclear how patients with SSc use these therapies. This study sought to characterise patient engagement and experiences with cosmetic therapies for SSc-related and non-SSc-related facial changes. SSc patients enrolled in the Australian Scleroderma Cohort Study at three Australian public tertiary hospitals and one private practice were invited to complete a de-identified questionnaire. Participants were asked about their engagement and perceived outcomes with cosmetic therapies including topical cosmeceuticals, injectable therapies, energy based devices/laser therapies and surgical procedures for facial changes. Descriptive statistics were analysed. Of the 616 patients invited, 241 participants completed the questionnaire with 119 (49.4%) responders reporting previously or currently considering a facial cosmetic therapy and 55 (22.8%) reporting use of at least one therapy. Of those who considered but did not go ahead with a therapy, 32 (50.0%) did not proceed due to cost and 24 (37.5%) due to safety concerns. A total of 159 facial cosmetic therapies were reported. These included topical cosmeceuticals (42.1%), injectable therapies (32.1%), energy based devices/laser therapies (22.6%) and surgical procedures (2.5%). Almost two thirds (64.2%) were performed for SSc-related facial changes. Responders reported perceived improvement with 116 (73.0%) cosmetic therapies and adverse events for 25 (15.7%). Most adverse events were mild. Patients with SSc engage broadly with cosmetic therapies for both SSc-related and non-SSc-related facial changes. Most users reported subjective improvement and few serious adverse effects were reported.

items.titleZh: 系统性硬化症患者的面部美容治疗使用：一项澳大利亚队列研究。
items.abstractZh: 系统性硬化症（SSc）与多种面部表现相关，患者可能会接受美容治疗。目前尚不清楚SSc患者如何使用这些治疗。本研究旨在描述患者对SSc相关及非SSc相关面部变化的美容治疗的参与情况和体验。在澳大利亚三个公立三级医院和一个私人诊所参加澳大利亚硬皮病队列研究的SSc患者被邀请完成一份去标识化问卷。参与者被问及他们对美容治疗的参与情况和感知结果，包括外用功效性护肤品、注射治疗、能量设备/激光治疗以及针对面部变化的手术程序。对描述性统计进行了分析。在受邀的616名患者中，241名参与者完成了问卷，其中119名（49.4%）应答者报告曾考虑或正在考虑面部美容治疗，55名（22.8%）报告使用了至少一种治疗。在考虑但未进行治疗的应答者中，32名（50.0%）因费用而未进行，24名（37.5%）因安全问题而未进行。共报告了159种面部美容治疗。这些包括外用功效性护肤品（42.1%）、注射治疗（32.1%）、能量设备/激光治疗（22.6%）和手术程序（2.5%）。几乎三分之二（64.2%）是针对SSc相关的面部变化进行的。应答者报告了感知改善，涉及116种（73.0%）美容治疗，以及25种（15.7%）不良事件。大多数不良事件为轻度。SSc患者广泛参与针对SSc相关和非SSc相关面部变化的美容治疗。大多数使用者报告主观改善，且报告了少数严重不良事件。

items.title: Risk of Cancer according to Duration of Targeted Therapy Exposure in Spondyloarthritis: A Nationwide Cohort Study from the French Health Insurance Database.
items.abstract: To assess the association between duration of targeted therapy exposure and cancer risk in patients with spondyloarthritis (SpA), including those with psoriatic arthritis, axial SpA, and other subtypes. This nationwide cohort study used the French health insurance database to identify adults with SpA initiating a targeted therapy (TNFi, IL17i, IL12/23i, IL23i, JAKi) from January 2014 to September 2022. Patients with prior cancer, HIV infection, or organ transplantation were excluded. Follow-up began after a 3-month delay and continued until December 2024. Exposure was assessed annually and classified as ≤6 or >6 months per year. Incident cancer was the primary outcome. Weighted Cox marginal structural models with inverse probability of treatment and censoring weights were used. A post hoc sensitivity analysis evaluated cumulative exposure trajectories over time. We included 56,591 patients (53.9% women; mean age 44±13 years; median follow-up 5.0 years). During follow-up, 1,224 cancers occurred (1,029 solid, 116 hematological, 79 unclassified). Exposure >6 versus ≤6 months was associated with a lower risk of overall cancer (weighted HR 0.86, 95%CI 0.75-0.99). In subgroup analyses, this association was observed for hematological malignancies (wHR 0.65, 95%CI 0.42-0.99) but not for solid cancers (wHR 0.92, 95%CI 0.79-1.07). Cumulative exposure history was not associated with cancer risk. In this nationwide study, prolonged exposure to targeted therapies was not associated with an increased cancer risk. Exposure >6 months per year was associated with a lower cancer risk, mainly for hematological malignancies, whereas cumulative exposure over multiple years was not associated with cancer risk.

items.titleZh: 脊柱关节炎靶向治疗暴露持续时间与癌症风险：来自法国健康保险数据库的全国性队列研究
items.abstractZh: 旨在评估脊柱关节炎（SpA）患者（包括银屑病关节炎、中轴型SpA及其他亚型）靶向治疗暴露持续时间与癌症风险之间的关联。这项全国性队列研究使用法国健康保险数据库，确定了2014年1月至2022年9月期间启动靶向治疗（TNFi、IL17i、IL12/23i、IL23i、JAKi）的成人SpA患者。排除既往有癌症、HIV感染或器官移植的患者。随访在3个月延迟后开始，持续至2024年12月。暴露每年评估一次，并分类为每年≤6个月或>6个月。主要结局为偶发癌症。使用具有治疗和删失逆概率权重的加权Cox边际结构模型。事后敏感性分析评估了随时间累积的暴露轨迹。我们纳入了56,591名患者（53.9%为女性；平均年龄44±13岁；中位随访5.0年）。随访期间，发生1,224例癌症（1,029例实体瘤，116例血液系统恶性肿瘤，79例未分类）。暴露>6个月与≤6个月相比，总体癌症风险较低（加权HR 0.86，95%CI 0.75-0.99）。在亚组分析中，这种关联见于血液系统恶性肿瘤（wHR 0.65，95%CI 0.42-0.99），但实体癌未见（wHR 0.92，95%CI 0.79-1.07）。累积暴露史与癌症风险无关。在这项全国性研究中，长期暴露于靶向治疗与癌症风险增加无关。每年暴露>6个月与较低的癌症风险相关，主要针对血液系统恶性肿瘤，而多年累积暴露与癌症风险无关。

items.title: Clinical field tests to evaluate cardiorespiratory fitness in psoriatic arthritis.
items.abstract: Cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF) is reduced in patients with psoriatic arthritis (PsA), highlighting the need for a consistent assessment of CRF in clinical practice. This study aimed to examine the associations between outcomes of clinical field tests, namely six-minute walk test (6MWT) and handgrip strength (HGS), and CRF, as well as to evaluate the accuracy of these clinical field tests in detecting impaired CRF in patients with PsA. Distance walked during 6WMT (6MWD), HGS by hand dynamometry, and maximal CRF as peak oxygen uptake (VO 2 peak, ml/min/kg) by cardiopulmonary exercise testing were assessed. 6MWD and HGS were compared to reference charts of the general population using one-sided t-tests. Spearman's rank correlation coefficients (r s ), multivariable linear regression models and receiver operating curves were analysed to study associations. In 80 PsA patients, 6MWD was strongly associated with VO 2 peak (r S =0.65, p<0.001), with the multivariable linear regression model, consisting of 6MWD and 6MWT heart rate response and adjusted for relevant covariates, explaining 70% of variance in VO 2 peak. The threshold of 108%predicted 6MWD had sensitivity of 75% and specificity of 64% to identify patients with impaired CRF. 6MWD and HGS were not significantly decreased compared to the general population (p>0.05). A higher 6MWD was moderately to strongly correlated with more favourable outcomes regarding disease activity, cardiometabolic risk, and patient-reported outcomes. No or only weak associations between HGS and VO 2 peak as well as clinical outcomes were noted. 6MWD was strongly associated with VO 2 peak, moderately to strongly correlated with important clinical outcomes and had adequate accuracy to detect patients with impaired CRF.

items.titleZh: 银屑病关节炎心肺适能的临床现场测试评估
items.abstractZh: 银屑病关节炎（PsA）患者的心肺适能（CRF）降低，凸显了在临床实践中对CRF进行一致评估的必要性。本研究旨在探讨临床现场测试结果（即六分钟步行试验（6MWT）和握力（HGS））与CRF之间的关联，并评估这些临床现场测试在检测PsA患者CRF受损方面的准确性。通过心肺运动试验评估了6MWT步行距离（6MWD）、手握测力法测得的HGS以及最大CRF（以峰值摄氧量VO 2 peak，ml/min/kg表示）。使用单侧t检验将6MWD和HGS与一般人群的参考图表进行比较。分析了Spearman秩相关系数（r s）、多元线性回归模型和受试者工作特征曲线以研究关联。在80名PsA患者中，6MWD与VO 2 peak强相关（r S =0.65，p<0.001），由6MWD和6MWT心率反应组成并经相关协变量调整的多元线性回归模型解释了VO 2 peak变异的70%。108%预测6MWD的阈值识别CRF受损患者的敏感性为75%，特异性为64%。与一般人群相比，6MWD和HGS未显著降低（p>0.05）。较高的6MWD与疾病活动度、心脏代谢风险和患者报告结局的更有利结果呈中度至强相关。HGS与VO 2 peak及临床结局之间无关联或仅弱关联。6MWD与VO 2 peak强相关，与重要临床结局中度至强相关，并且具有足够的准确性来检测CRF受损患者。

items.title: Circ_0024085 and circ_0000339 as potential biomarkers for the diagnosis of ankylosing spondylitis.
items.abstract: This study aimed to identify novel circular RNA (circRNA) biomarkers in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) for the diagnosis of ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and to explore their potential pathogenic mechanisms. High-throughput circRNA sequencing was performed on PBMCs from 3 AS patients and 3 healthy controls. Differentially expressed circRNAs were validated by RT-qPCR in an independent cohort (64 AS patients and 24 healthy individuals). Diagnostic performance was evaluated via ROC curve analysis. Correlations between circRNA expression and clinical inflammatory markers were assessed. Bioinformatics analysis was employed to predict target miRNAs and enriched signaling pathways. A total of 53 circRNAs were differentially expressed in AS PBMCs. Among these, circ_0024085 and circ_0000339 were significantly upregulated in AS (41.6-fold and 27.0-fold, p  < 0.05), and demonstrated good diagnostic performance (AUC = 0.815 for the combination). The expression of Circ_0024085 was inversely correlated with erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR, p  = 0.005) and monocyte count ( p  = 0.027). Bioinformatic analysis indicated that the target miRNAs of circ_0024085 were significantly enriched in the IL‑4/IL‑13 signaling pathway, while those of circ_0000339 were enriched in the SEMA4D signaling pathway. Our findings identify circ_0024085 and circ_0000339 as potential diagnostic biomarkers for AS. With bioinformatics predictions indicating that Circ_0024085 may exert an anti-inflammatory effect via M2 macrophage polarization, whereas circ_0000339 might contribute to bone damage through SEMA4D signaling.

items.titleZh: Circ_0024085和circ_0000339作为强直性脊柱炎诊断的潜在生物标志物
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在鉴定外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）中用于诊断强直性脊柱炎（AS）的新型环状RNA（circRNA）生物标志物，并探讨其潜在的致病机制。对3名AS患者和3名健康对照者的PBMCs进行了高通量circRNA测序。在独立队列（64名AS患者和24名健康个体）中通过RT-qPCR验证差异表达的circRNA。通过ROC曲线分析评估诊断性能。评估了circRNA表达与临床炎症标志物之间的相关性。采用生物信息学分析预测靶向miRNA和富集的信号通路。在AS PBMCs中共有53个circRNA差异表达。其中，circ_0024085和circ_0000339在AS中显著上调（41.6倍和27.0倍，p < 0.05），并表现出良好的诊断性能（组合AUC = 0.815）。Circ_0024085的表达与红细胞沉降率（ESR，p = 0.005）和单核细胞计数（p = 0.027）呈负相关。生物信息学分析表明，circ_0024085的靶向miRNA显著富集于IL-4/IL-13信号通路，而circ_0000339的靶向miRNA富集于SEMA4D信号通路。我们的研究结果确定circ_0024085和circ_0000339为AS的潜在诊断生物标志物。生物信息学预测表明，Circ_0024085可能通过M2巨噬细胞极化发挥抗炎作用，而circ_0000339可能通过SEMA4D信号传导促进骨损伤。

items.title: Tim-3 Upregulation in Monocyte Subsets as a Distinctive Immune Feature and Early Diagnostic Indicator in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.
items.abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a complex autoimmune disease characterized by immune dysregulation. Tim-3 is an immune checkpoint receptor implicated in various autoimmune conditions. This study aimed to evaluate Tim-3 expression across monocyte subsets in newly diagnosed, treatment-naive SLE patients and assess its clinical relevance and diagnostic potential. Peripheral blood samples were analyzed using flow cytometry. Tim-3 expression and its co-expression with HLA-DR/DP/DQ, CD226, and CD62L were assessed. Results showed significantly elevated Tim-3 expression in all monocyte subsets in SLE patients compared to controls. Tim-3+ monocytes exhibited decreased VNN2 level, indicating an activated antigen-presenting phenotype. Upon LPS stimulation, Tim-3+ monocyte subsets secreted more TNF-α. The frequency of Tim-3+ monocytes positively correlated with anti-Ro52 and anti-SSA antibodies, negatively with C3 and IgM levels. ROC curve analysis demonstrated that Tim-3+ monocytes had moderate diagnostic performance for SLE, with area under the curve values of 0.7901. These findings suggest that Tim-3+ monocytes may serve as potential biomarkers for early SLE diagnosis.

items.titleZh: 单核细胞亚群中Tim-3上调作为系统性红斑狼疮的独特免疫特征和早期诊断指标
items.abstractZh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种以免疫失调为特征的复杂自身免疫性疾病。Tim-3是一种参与多种自身免疫性疾病的免疫检查点受体。本研究旨在评估新诊断、未接受治疗SLE患者单核细胞亚群中Tim-3的表达，并评估其临床相关性和诊断潜力。使用流式细胞术分析外周血样本。评估了Tim-3表达及其与HLA-DR/DP/DQ、CD226和CD62L的共表达。结果显示，与对照组相比，SLE患者所有单核细胞亚群中Tim-3表达显著升高。Tim-3+单核细胞表现出VNN2水平降低，表明其具有活化的抗原呈递表型。在LPS刺激下，Tim-3+单核细胞亚群分泌更多TNF-α。Tim-3+单核细胞的频率与抗Ro52和抗SSA抗体呈正相关，与C3和IgM水平呈负相关。ROC曲线分析表明，Tim-3+单核细胞对SLE具有中等诊断性能，曲线下面积值为0.7901。这些发现提示Tim-3+单核细胞可能作为SLE早期诊断的潜在生物标志物。

items.title: [A case of juvenile dermatomyositis complicated by T-lymphoblastic lymphoma].
items.abstract: 患儿，女，12岁1月龄，主诉“面部潮红、颈部淋巴结肿大11 d”。结合患儿影像学检查、骨髓涂片细胞学检查、骨髓流式细胞学检查及淋巴结活检诊断T淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤。患儿持续肌酸激酶升高并出现近端肌无力，肌炎相关抗体、肌肉磁共振成像及肌电图检查支持幼年型皮肌炎诊断。患儿接受T淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤规范化学治疗，同时兼顾幼年型皮肌炎治疗，3个月后肌酸激酶恢复正常，肌力较前改善。幼年型皮肌炎合并恶性肿瘤比较罕见，对于伴持续肌酶升高及近端肌无力的淋巴瘤患儿，应警惕幼年型皮肌炎的可能。.

items.title: From Sight to Stridor: Recurrent Angioedema in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Associated With Complement Activation.
items.abstract: BACKGROUND Angioedema is a rare manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) that can lead to life-threatening complications, including airway compromise. Acquired angioedema is classically associated with C1 esterase inhibitor (C1-INH) deficiency caused either by increased consumption of C1-INH or the development of autoantibodies against C1-INH. However, emerging reports describe patients with active SLE who develop recurrent angioedema despite preserved C1-INH levels and function, suggesting a possible complement-mediated or bradykinin-associated inflammatory phenotype that remains incompletely characterized. CASE REPORT We report the case of a woman in her early 20s with SLE and lupus nephritis who presented with a urinary tract infection and unilateral periorbital edema. Initial laboratory evaluation revealed anemia, thrombocytopenia, and acute-on-chronic kidney injury. She was treated with antibiotics for presumed urinary tract infection and preseptal cellulitis. During hospitalization, she developed laryngeal edema requiring prompt treatment with intravenous dexamethasone, with rapid clinical improvement. Further evaluation demonstrated low C4 and C1q complement levels, elevated C1q complement binding levels, elevated anti-C1q antibodies, and preserved C1-INH antigen and functional levels, raising suspicion for complement-mediated angioedema occurring in the setting of active SLE. Over the ensuing 6 months, she experienced recurrent episodes of angioedema with progressive renal dysfunction and concern for evolving macrophage activation syndrome or severe hyperinflammatory immune activation. CONCLUSIONS This case highlights a rare presentation of recurrent angioedema associated with active SLE and complement activation despite preserved C1-INH levels and function. The case underscores the importance of early recognition of airway involvement in patients with lupus and illustrates the diagnostic challenges surrounding complement-mediated angioedema phenotypes in autoimmune disease.

items.titleZh: 从视力到喘鸣：系统性红斑狼疮中与补体激活相关的复发性血管性水肿。
items.abstractZh: BACKGROUND 血管性水肿是系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）的一种罕见表现，可导致危及生命的并发症，包括气道受损。获得性血管性水肿经典上与C1酯酶抑制剂（C1-INH）缺乏相关，其原因或是C1-INH消耗增加，或是产生了针对C1-INH的自身抗体。然而，新兴报告描述了部分活动性SLE患者尽管C1-INH水平和功能正常，仍出现复发性血管性水肿，提示可能存在一种尚未完全明确的补体介导或缓激肽相关的炎症表型。CASE REPORT 我们报告一例20岁出头的女性患者，患有SLE和狼疮性肾炎，表现为尿路感染和单侧眶周水肿。初步实验室检查显示贫血、血小板减少症和慢性肾脏病急性加重。她因疑似尿路感染和眶隔前蜂窝织炎接受了抗生素治疗。住院期间，她出现喉头水肿，需立即静脉注射地塞米松治疗，临床迅速改善。进一步评估显示C4和C1q补体水平降低，C1q补体结合水平升高，抗C1q抗体升高，而C1-INH抗原和功能水平正常，这提示在活动性SLE背景下发生了补体介导的血管性水肿。在随后的6个月中，她反复出现血管性水肿发作，伴有进行性肾功能障碍，并担心可能发展为巨噬细胞活化综合征或严重的过度炎症性免疫激活。CONCLUSIONS 本病例突显了一种罕见表现：尽管C1-INH水平和功能正常，但与活动性SLE和补体激活相关的复发性血管性水肿。该病例强调了早期识别狼疮患者气道受累的重要性，并说明了自身免疫性疾病中补体介导的血管性水肿表型在诊断上的挑战。

items.title: Bimekizumab efficacy in male and female patients with axial spondyloarthritis: 52-week results from the Phase 3 BE MOBILE rials.
items.abstract: To assess sex-based differences in response to bimekizumab in patients with axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) from two phase 3 trials. Improvements to Week 52 in measures of disease activity (ASAS40, ASDAS <2.1, BASDAI) and function (BASFI), pain, fatigue, health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and objective signs of inflammation (MRI, hs-CRP) were assessed post hoc in patients with non-radiographic (nr-) and radiographic (r-)axSpA from BE MOBILE 1 (NCT03928704) and BE MOBILE 2 (NCT03928743), respectively. Comparisons were made between sexes at Week 16 (bimekizumab versus placebo treatment effect) and Week 52 (treatment response in bimekizumab-randomised patients only) using odds ratios for dichotomous outcomes and difference values for continuous outcomes. For hs-CRP, ratio to baseline was calculated due to skewed distribution. While sex distribution was balanced in nr-axSpA (54.3% male), 72.3% of patients with r-axSpA were male. At Week 16, bimekizumab-randomised male patients typically had better treatment responses versus placebo compared with female patients across ASAS40, ASDAS <2.1 and improvements in BASDAI, BASFI and measures of HRQoL. At Week 52, female patients had longer-term improvements across these outcomes, though male patients continued to have numerically higher treatment responses. In contrast, active inflammation (MRI, hs-CRP) was reduced to similarly low levels in both sexes at Week 16 and maintained to Week 52, despite baseline differences. Although male patients had earlier clinical responses to bimekizumab treatment, female patients demonstrated longer-term improvements in composite and patient-reported outcomes. Both sexes had substantial improvements in objective inflammation at Week 16 and 52, despite baseline differences. Clinicaltrials.gov; NCT03928704 and NCT03928743.

items.titleZh: 比美吉珠单抗在男性和女性中轴型脊柱关节炎患者中的疗效：来自3期BE MOBILE试验的52周结果。
items.abstractZh: 旨在评估来自两项3期试验的中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）患者对比美吉珠单抗反应的性别差异。对BE MOBILE 1（NCT03928704）和BE MOBILE 2（NCT03928743）中非放射学（nr-）和放射学（r-）axSpA患者，在第52周时疾病活动度（ASAS40、ASDAS <2.1、BASDAI）和功能（BASFI）、疼痛、疲劳、健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）以及炎症客观指标（MRI、hs-CRP）的改善进行了事后评估。在第16周（比美吉珠单抗与安慰剂治疗效应）和第52周（仅比美吉珠单抗随机分组患者的治疗反应）进行了性别间比较，使用比值比表示二分结果，差值表示连续结果。对于hs-CRP，由于分布偏斜，计算了相对于基线的比率。虽然nr-axSpA中性别分布均衡（男性54.3%），但r-axSpA患者中72.3%为男性。在第16周，与安慰剂相比，随机分配至比美吉珠单抗的男性患者通常在ASAS40、ASDAS <2.1以及BASDAI、BASFI和HRQoL指标的改善方面比女性患者有更好的治疗反应。在第52周，女性患者在这些结果上有长期改善，尽管男性患者的治疗反应数值上仍较高。相比之下，尽管基线存在差异，两性在第16周的活动性炎症（MRI、hs-CRP）均降至相似低水平，并维持至第52周。尽管男性患者对比美吉珠单抗治疗有更早的临床反应，但女性患者在复合和患者报告结局方面表现出更长期的改善。尽管基线存在差异，两性在第16周和第52周的客观炎症均有显著改善。Clinicaltrials.gov；NCT03928704和NCT03928743。

items.title: Clinical characteristics of IgG4-related disease patients with different serum IgG4 levels: A single-center retrospective study.
items.abstract: ObjectiveImmunoglobulin G4-related disease is a rare autoimmune disorder, and serum immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) levels vary among patients. This study aimed to systematically compare the clinical features of patients with immunoglobulin G4-related disease across different serum IgG4 levels to improve understanding of disease heterogeneity.MethodsThis retrospective observational study enrolled 77 patients with immunoglobulin G4-related disease admitted to Yichang Central People's Hospital from January 2019 to April 2025.ResultsAmong the 77 patients with immunoglobulin G4-related disease, 13 (16.88%) had serum IgG4 levels ≤ the upper limit of normal (ULN), 19 (24.68%) had levels within the range of ULN <IgG4< 2 × ULN, 25 (32.47%) had levels within the range of 2 × ULN ≤IgG4 <5 × ULN, and 20 (25.97%) had serum IgG4 levels ≥5 × ULN. The incidence of multiorgan involvement was higher in patients with serum IgG4 levels ≥5 × ULN than in patients with serum IgG4 levels ≤ULN and those with 2 × ULN ≤IgG4 <5 × ULN (p = 0.007). Additionally, the prevalence of lymph node involvement was significantly higher in patients with serum IgG4 levels ≥5 × ULN than in those with 2 × ULN ≤IgG4 <5 × ULN (p = 0.013). Patients with serum IgG4 levels ≥5 × ULN had higher total protein (p = 0.007), globulin (p < 0.001), and immunoglobulin G (p < 0.001) levels than patients with serum IgG4 levels ≤ ULN and those with 2 × ULN ≤IgG4 <5 × ULN. They also had lower serum albumin levels than patients with 2 × ULN ≤IgG4 <5 × ULN (p  =  0.012) and reduced complement C3 levels than patients with serum IgG4 levels ≤ULN (p = 0.028). Moreover, serum IgG4 levels were positively correlated with serum IgG (r = 0.410, p < 0.001), total protein (r = 0.303, p = 0.008), and globulin (r = 0.363, p = 0.001) levels and negatively correlated with complement C3 levels (r = -0.383, p = 0.002).ConclusionsPatients with immunoglobulin G4-related disease may exhibit diverse clinical characteristics according to their serum IgG4 levels. Clinicians should consider variations in serum IgG4 levels when assessing and managing patients with immunoglobulin G4-related disease.

items.titleZh: 不同血清IgG4水平的IgG4相关疾病患者的临床特征：一项单中心回顾性研究
items.abstractZh: 目的免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病是一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病，患者血清免疫球蛋白G4（IgG4）水平各异。本研究旨在系统比较不同血清IgG4水平的免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病患者的临床特征，以提高对该疾病异质性的认识。方法本回顾性观察研究纳入了2019年1月至2025年4月期间在宜昌市中心人民医院住院的77例免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病患者。结果在77例免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病患者中，13例（16.88%）血清IgG4水平≤正常上限（ULN），19例（24.68%）水平在ULN<IgG4<2×ULN范围内，25例（32.47%）水平在2×ULN≤IgG4<5×ULN范围内，20例（25.97%）血清IgG4水平≥5×ULN。血清IgG4水平≥5×ULN的患者多器官受累的发生率高于血清IgG4水平≤ULN的患者和2×ULN≤IgG4<5×ULN的患者（p = 0.007）。此外，血清IgG4水平≥5×ULN的患者淋巴结受累的患病率显著高于2×ULN≤IgG4<5×ULN的患者（p = 0.013）。血清IgG4水平≥5×ULN的患者总蛋白（p = 0.007）、球蛋白（p < 0.001）和免疫球蛋白G（p < 0.001）水平高于血清IgG4水平≤ULN的患者和2×ULN≤IgG4<5×ULN的患者。他们的血清白蛋白水平也低于2×ULN≤IgG4<5×ULN的患者（p = 0.012），补体C3水平低于血清IgG4水平≤ULN的患者（p = 0.028）。此外，血清IgG4水平与血清IgG（r = 0.410，p < 0.001）、总蛋白（r = 0.303，p = 0.008）和球蛋白（r = 0.363，p = 0.001）水平呈正相关，与补体C3水平呈负相关（r = -0.383，p = 0.002）。结论免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病患者可能根据其血清IgG4水平表现出不同的临床特征。临床医生在评估和管理免疫球蛋白G4相关疾病患者时应考虑血清IgG4水平的差异。

items.title: Comorbid Inflammatory Diseases in Behçet's Disease: A Multicenter Large Cohort Study.
items.abstract: Behçet's disease (BD) is a chronic, multisystem immune-mediated vasculitis. A significant number of patients with BD have inflammatory comorbid (IC) disease that can affect the clinical course of the disease. In the current literature, there is no study which investigated IC disease in BD. It was aimed to show the prevalence and clinical spectrum of IC disease in patients with BD. A total of 1591 patients diagnosed with BD and followed at five tertiary healthcare facilities were enrolled in the study. Patients were divided according to the presence of IC disease. Demographic characteristics, clinical manifestations, and laboratory parameters were systematically noted from medical records. The activity of the disease was evaluated by Behçet's Disease Current Activity Form (BDCAF). Inflammatory comorbid diseases were identified in 246 (15.3%) patients. The most common comorbidities were axial spondyloarthritis (n = 115, 7.2%), familial Mediterranean fever (FMF) (n = 38, 2.4%), and hidradenitis suppurativa (n = 37, 2.3%). Patients with IC disease had a greater use of anti-TNF treatment (p = 0.03). In the multivariate analysis, older age, and longer disease duration were found to be significantly associated with IC disease in BD (p < 0.05). BD can be associated with other inflammatory conditions. Furthermore, patients with inflammatory comorbidities were more likely to receive anti-TNF therapy, although this may partly reflect treatment indications for the comorbid conditions themselves. Therefore, clinicians should remain vigilant for inflammatory comorbidities, as their recognition may have implications for therapeutic decision-making.

items.titleZh: 白塞病中的炎症性共病：一项多中心大型队列研究
items.abstractZh: 白塞病（BD）是一种慢性、多系统免疫介导的血管炎。相当数量的BD患者患有炎症性共病（IC），这可能影响疾病的临床病程。在目前的文献中，尚无研究探讨BD中的IC疾病。本研究旨在显示BD患者中IC疾病的患病率和临床谱。研究共纳入1591例确诊为BD并在五家三级医疗机构随访的患者。根据是否存在IC疾病对患者进行分组。系统记录医疗记录中的人口统计学特征、临床表现和实验室参数。疾病活动度通过白塞病当前活动表（BDCAF）进行评估。在246例（15.3%）患者中发现了炎症性共病。最常见的共病是轴性脊柱关节炎（n=115，7.2%）、家族性地中海热（FMF）（n=38，2.4%）和化脓性汗腺炎（n=37，2.3%）。患有IC疾病的患者使用抗TNF治疗的比例更高（p=0.03）。在多变量分析中，年龄较大和病程较长与BD中的IC疾病显著相关（p<0.05）。BD可与其他炎症性疾病相关。此外，患有炎症性共病的患者更可能接受抗TNF治疗，尽管这可能部分反映了共病本身的治疗指征。因此，临床医生应对炎症性共病保持警惕，因为识别这些共病可能对治疗决策产生影响。

items.title: Multisystem Hepatic Sarcoidosis With Hypereosinophilia and Elevated IgG4 Mimicking IgG4-Related Disease and Lymphoma: A Diagnostic Challenge.
items.abstract: Sarcoidosis is a multisystem granulomatous disease that can involve multiple organ systems, present with varied clinical features, and overlap diagnostically with malignancy and immune-mediated disorders. We report the case of a 39-year-old woman who presented with mild dyspnea, generalized weakness, and unintentional weight loss, accompanied by marked hypereosinophilia. Laboratory evaluation revealed a cholestatic pattern of liver injury, elevated total serum IgG, markedly elevated serum IgG4, elevated serum IgE, polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia, and elevated serum angiotensin-converting enzyme levels. Cross-sectional imaging demonstrated marked hepatosplenomegaly with multiple nodular lesions, extensive abdominal and mediastinal lymphadenopathy, and bilateral subpleural pulmonary nodules. Given these findings, an infiltrative or malignant process was initially suspected. Excisional lymph node biopsy revealed non-necrotizing granulomatous inflammation consistent with sarcoidosis. Bone marrow aspiration and biopsy demonstrated preserved hematopoiesis without abnormal cellular infiltration, while acid-fast bacilli staining and mycobacterial cultures were negative, effectively excluding hematologic malignancy, tuberculosis, and primary hypereosinophilic syndromes. This case expands the limited literature on hepatic sarcoidosis presenting with marked hypereosinophilia and elevated serum IgG4, emphasizing the importance of histopathological confirmation and systematic exclusion of alternative diagnoses.

items.titleZh: 多系统肝结节病伴高嗜酸性粒细胞增多和IgG4升高，类似IgG4相关疾病和淋巴瘤：一项诊断挑战。
items.abstractZh: 结节病是一种多系统肉芽肿性疾病，可累及多个器官系统，临床表现多样，并在诊断上与恶性肿瘤和免疫介导性疾病重叠。我们报告一例39岁女性患者，表现为轻度呼吸困难、全身乏力和非自愿性体重减轻，伴有显著的高嗜酸性粒细胞增多。实验室检查显示胆汁淤积性肝损伤模式、总血清IgG升高、血清IgG4显著升高、血清IgE升高、多克隆高丙种球蛋白血症以及血清血管紧张素转换酶水平升高。横断面成像显示显著的肝脾肿大伴多个结节性病变、广泛的腹部和纵隔淋巴结肿大，以及双侧胸膜下肺结节。鉴于这些发现，最初怀疑为浸润性或恶性过程。切除性淋巴结活检显示非坏死性肉芽肿性炎症，符合结节病。骨髓穿刺和活检显示造血功能保留，无异常细胞浸润，而抗酸杆菌染色和分枝杆菌培养均为阴性，有效排除了血液系统恶性肿瘤、结核病和原发性高嗜酸性粒细胞综合征。本病例扩展了关于肝结节病伴显著高嗜酸性粒细胞增多和血清IgG4升高的有限文献，强调了组织病理学确认和系统排除其他诊断的重要性。

items.title: Cross-sectional imaging in an inferior vena cava agenesis associated with antiphospholipid syndrome, lower limb, and portomesenteric deep vein thrombosis and renal insufficiency in a young patient: A rare presentation.
items.abstract: Inferior vena cava (IVC) agenesis is a rare congenital anomaly (prevalence 0.0005%-1%) often asymptomatic but can be complicated by deep vein thrombosis, particularly in the presence of acquired thrombophilia. There are 2 major presentations reported in literature, infrahepatic IVC agenesis associated mostly with lower-limb thrombosis and intrahepatic IVC agenesis associated frequently with splanchnic thrombosis and pulmonary embolism. We report the case of a 38-year-old man presenting with chronic bilateral leg ulcers evolving for 3 years. Cross-sectional imaging demonstrated partial agenesis of intra-hepatic IVC and complete agenesis of the infra-hepatic IVC up to the iliac bifurcation, a massive compensatory collateral network involving the azygos vein, hemiazygos, lumbar, and abdominal parietal systems, as well as multiple venous thrombosis of the portal vein, mesenteric vein, azygos vein and lower-limbs. The iliac veins drained via ascending lumbar veins to the hypertrophied azygos system. Morphology CT analysis showed a focal right renal infarct, but no atrophy was noted. Laboratory workup revealed a probable antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) and severe antithrombin III deficiency (22%), nephrotic syndrome, and alteration in glomerular filtration. This case illustrates the importance of recognizing radiological signs of IVC agenesis, particularly in the presence of atypical thrombosis or unexplained leg ulcers. The association with probable APS, multiple visceral thrombosis and renal function altered, makes this case exceptionally rare and educationally important.

items.titleZh: 下腔静脉缺如合并抗磷脂综合征、下肢及门肠系膜深静脉血栓形成和肾功能不全的年轻患者横断面影像学表现：一例罕见病例报告
items.abstractZh: 下腔静脉（IVC）缺如是一种罕见的先天性异常（患病率0.0005%-1%），通常无症状，但可并发深静脉血栓形成，尤其是在存在获得性血栓形成倾向时。文献报道了两种主要表现形式：肝下型IVC缺如主要与下肢血栓形成相关，而肝内型IVC缺如常与内脏静脉血栓形成和肺栓塞相关。我们报告一例38岁男性患者，表现为慢性双侧腿部溃疡，病程3年。横断面影像学显示肝内IVC部分缺如，肝下IVC完全缺如直至髂动脉分叉处，存在大量代偿性侧支循环网络，涉及奇静脉、半奇静脉、腰静脉和腹壁系统，以及门静脉、肠系膜静脉、奇静脉和下肢的多发静脉血栓形成。髂静脉通过升腰静脉引流至肥大的奇静脉系统。形态学CT分析显示右肾局灶性梗死，但未见萎缩。实验室检查提示可能存在抗磷脂综合征（APS）和严重的抗凝血酶III缺乏（22%）、肾病综合征以及肾小球滤过功能改变。本例强调了识别IVC缺如放射学征象的重要性，尤其是在存在非典型血栓形成或不明原因腿部溃疡时。与可能的APS、多发性内脏血栓形成和肾功能改变的相关性，使本例极为罕见且具有教学意义。

items.title: Agranulocytosis associated with metamizole among EudraVigilance reports involving methotrexate for rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: Methotrexate (MTX) can induce adverse drug reactions (ADRs) including severe haematotoxic events. This study analyses whether agranulocytosis is disproportionately reported in spontaneous reports involving MTX for rheumatoid arthritis (RA) when use of metamizole, a non-opioid analgesic, which itself has been associated with agranulocytosis, is recorded additionally. Using the EudraVigilance database, we analyzed spontaneous reports of suspected ADRs associated with MTX for RA and including any comedication (from Europe, until 2022). We (i) compared characteristics of reports stratified by metamizole use and the occurrence of agranulocytosis and (ii) performed disproportionality analyses estimating reporting odds ratios (RORs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) of agranulocytosis associated with metamizole. We included 7,213 reports with recorded use of MTX for RA (72.1% female, median age: 64 years, 11.3% with an agranulocytosis, 1.7% with metamizole use). Compared to reports with other comedication, metamizole users were older and more often received also other analgesics such as opioids (27.3% vs. 8.9%) while treatment with additional disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (DMARDs) was less common (34.7% vs. 62.2%). Agranulocytosis was disproportionately recorded in reports also involving metamizole (ROR: 9.8; 95% CI: 6.8-14.1). The ROR decreased after adjusting for age, sex, other analgesics and DMARDs (ROR: 5.5; 95% CI: 3.6-8.6). The highest ROR was found in individuals aged 80 + . Our study supports regulatory warnings that a concurrent administration of metamizole can increase the haematotoxic effect of MTX and should therefore be avoided. A sufficient RA therapy might decrease the need for analgesics and should be aimed at also in older RA patients.

items.titleZh: 甲氨蝶呤治疗类风湿关节炎的EudraVigilance报告中与安乃近相关的粒细胞缺乏症
items.abstractZh: 甲氨蝶呤（MTX）可诱发药物不良反应（ADR），包括严重的血液毒性事件。本研究分析了在涉及MTX治疗类风湿关节炎（RA）的自发报告中，当额外记录使用安乃近（一种非阿片类镇痛药，其本身与粒细胞缺乏症相关）时，粒细胞缺乏症是否被不成比例地报告。利用EudraVigilance数据库，我们分析了与MTX治疗RA相关的可疑ADR自发报告，并包括任何合并用药（来自欧洲，截至2022年）。我们（i）比较了按安乃近使用和粒细胞缺乏症发生分层的报告特征，并（ii）进行了不成比例分析，估计与安乃近相关的粒细胞缺乏症的报告比值比（ROR）和95%置信区间（CI）。我们纳入了7,213份记录使用MTX治疗RA的报告（72.1%为女性，中位年龄：64岁，11.3%伴有粒细胞缺乏症，1.7%使用安乃近）。与其他合并用药的报告相比，安乃近使用者年龄更大，且更常同时接受其他镇痛药如阿片类药物（27.3% vs. 8.9%），而额外使用改善病情抗风湿药（DMARDs）的治疗较少见（34.7% vs. 62.2%）。在同时涉及安乃近的报告（ROR：9.8；95% CI：6.8-14.1）中，粒细胞缺乏症被不成比例地记录。调整年龄、性别、其他镇痛药和DMARDs后，ROR降低（ROR：5.5；95% CI：3.6-8.6）。在80岁及以上个体中发现的ROR最高。我们的研究支持监管警告，即同时使用安乃近可增加MTX的血液毒性作用，因此应避免。充分的RA治疗可能减少对镇痛药的需求，并且也应针对老年RA患者实现这一目标。

items.title: Disseminated Nocardia pseudobrasiliensis infection in a case of juvenile systemic lupus erythematosus on immunosuppressive therapy.
items.abstract: Nocardiosis is an uncommon infection that presents as a chronic, debilitating illness with radiographic manifestations simulating lung cancer or tuberculosis. Immunocompromised hosts may develop a fulminant disease resembling acute bacterial pneumonia or disseminated disease. We report a case of a juvenile lupus who developed disseminated Nocardia pseudobrasilienisis infection in form of necrotizing pneumonia, subcutaneous nodules and central nervous system (CNS) lesion in the right parietal lobe, following inadvertent hiking of steroids after a minor organ flare. This case was successfully treated with intravenous meropenem, amikacin, and oral cotrimoxazole therapy for 6 weeks which lead to resolution of pneumonia, and partial resolution of of the cutaneous and CNS lesion. As the patient was immunosuppressed, and had disseminated nocardiosis, we planned to put her on oral cotrimoxazole for the next 1 year.

items.titleZh: 免疫抑制治疗下青少年系统性红斑狼疮患者播散性假巴西诺卡菌感染一例
items.abstractZh: 诺卡菌病是一种不常见的感染，表现为慢性、消耗性疾病，影像学表现类似肺癌或结核病。免疫功能低下的宿主可能发展为暴发性疾病，类似急性细菌性肺炎或播散性疾病。我们报告一例青少年狼疮患者，在轻微器官发作后不慎增加类固醇剂量，发展为播散性假巴西诺卡菌感染，表现为坏死性肺炎、皮下结节和右顶叶中枢神经系统（CNS）病变。该病例经静脉注射美罗培南、阿米卡星和口服复方磺胺甲噁唑治疗6周成功，肺炎消退，皮肤和CNS病变部分消退。由于患者免疫功能低下且患有播散性诺卡菌病，我们计划让她口服复方磺胺甲噁唑治疗1年。

items.title: Psychometric validation and reliability of the Arabic version of the LupusQoL questionnaire (Ar-LupusQoL) in Egyptian patients with systemic lupus erythematosus.
items.abstract: IntroductionSystemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic multisystem autoimmune disease associated with impaired health-related quality of life (HRQoL). The LupusQoL is a disease-specific instrument designed to capture SLE-related HRQoL domains; however, a validated Arabic version remains unavailable.ObjectiveTo evaluate the reliability and validity of the Arabic version of LupusQoL (Ar-LupusQoL) in SLE Egyptian patients.MethodsIn this multicenter cross-sectional study, 156 patients with SLE completed the Arabic LupusQoL and Short Form-36 (SF-36). Disease activity and damage were assessed using Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Disease Activity Index (SLEDAI) and Systemic Lupus International Collaborating Clinics/American College of Rheumatology Damage Index (SLICC/ACR-DI), respectively. Internal consistency was assessed using Cronbach's alpha, and test-retest reliability using intraclass correlation coefficients. Construct validity was examined through item-total correlations and correlations with corresponding SF-36 domains. Discriminant validity was also evaluated.ResultsThe mean age was 33.37 ± 10.71 years, and 98.1% were female. The cohort demonstrated a high level of disease activity (87.2% with SLEDAI >4; mean SLEDAI 19.52 ± 16.20). Internal consistency was high across domains (α = 0.78-0.98). Item-total correlations were strong (r > 0.30, p < 0.001). Significant correlations with corresponding SF-36 domains supported convergent validity (r = 0.668-0.829, p < 0.05). The Ar-LupusQoL effectively discriminated between active and inactive disease ( p < 0.001). Ceiling effects were observed in selected domains, with no significant floor effects.ConclusionThe Arabic version of the LupusQoL is a reliable and valid instrument for assessing HRQoL in Egyptian patients with SLE. The high disease activity observed, likely reflecting recruitment from tertiary referral centers, may limit generalizability to patients with milder disease.

items.title: [Immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy: clinical and histopathological correlation].
items.abstract: Immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy (IMNM) is a variant of inflammatory myopathies, characterized by muscle fiber necrosis and regeneration with minimal inflammatory infiltration, associated with a potentially severe clinical course and difficult management. We report the case of a 64-year-old woman with a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus who presented with progressive proximal weakness, dysphagia, and prostration of one month's duration. She developed severe muscle involvement requiring subsequent mechanical ventilation. Initial studies showed markedly elevated creatine phosphokinase (CPK) levels (>10 000 U/L), and muscle biopsy revealed fiber necrosis and regeneration with scant inflammatory infiltrate, consistent with IMNM. Intensive treatment with methylprednisolone pulses and intravenous immunoglobulin was initiated, followed by the addition of methotrexate, azathioprine, and rituximab. Under this combined regimen, the patient showed a favourable evolution with progressive decline of CPK, functional recovery of muscle strength, and improvement of dysphagia, being discharged in ambulatory conditions with minimal assistance. An interdisciplinary approach and early implementation of intensive immunosuppression are essential to reverse unfavourable progression and optimize the functional prognosis of these patients. La miopatía necrotizante inmunomediada (MNI) constituye una variante dentro de las miopatías inflamatorias, caracterizada por necrosis y regeneración de fibras musculares con mínima infiltración inflamatoria, asociado a un curso clínico potencialmente grave y de difícil control. Se presenta el caso de una mujer de 64 años con antecedente de diabetes mellitus tipo 2, que consultó por debilidad proximal progresiva, disfagia y postración de un mes de evolución. Se constató compromiso muscular grave con requerimiento posterior de ventilación mecánica. Los estudios iniciales mostraron elevación marcada de creatinfosfoquinasa (CPK) >10 000 UI/L y la biopsia muscular evidenció necrosis y regeneración de fibras con escaso infiltrado, compatible con MNI. Se inició tratamiento intensivo con pulsos de metilprednisolona y gammaglobulina, al que posteriormente se agregaron metotrexato, azatioprina y rituximab. Bajo este esquema combinado la paciente mostró una evolución favorable con descenso progresivo de CPK, recuperación funcional de la fuerza y mejoría de la disfagia, siendo externada en condiciones de deambulación con mínima asistencia. El abordaje interdisciplinario y la implementación temprana de inmunosupresión intensiva son fundamentales para revertir la evolución desfavorable y optimizar el pronóstico funcional de los pacientes.

items.titleZh: 免疫介导坏死性肌病：临床与组织病理学相关性
items.abstractZh: 免疫介导坏死性肌病（IMNM）是炎症性肌病的一种变异型，其特征为肌纤维坏死和再生，伴有极少的炎症浸润，与潜在的严重临床病程和难以管理相关。我们报告一例64岁女性患者，有2型糖尿病病史，表现为进行性近端无力、吞咽困难和持续一个月的虚脱。她发展为严重的肌肉受累，随后需要机械通气。初步研究显示肌酸磷酸激酶（CPK）水平显著升高（>10 000 U/L），肌肉活检显示肌纤维坏死和再生，伴有少量炎症浸润，符合IMNM。开始使用甲泼尼龙脉冲和静脉注射免疫球蛋白进行强化治疗，随后加用甲氨蝶呤、硫唑嘌呤和利妥昔单抗。在这种联合方案下，患者表现出良好的进展，CPK逐渐下降，肌力功能恢复，吞咽困难改善，出院时可在最小辅助下行走。跨学科方法和早期实施强化免疫抑制对于逆转不利进展和优化这些患者的功能预后至关重要。MNI是一种炎症性肌病的变异型，其特征为肌纤维坏死和再生，伴有极少的炎症浸润，与潜在的严重临床病程和难以控制相关。报告一例64岁女性患者，有2型糖尿病病史，因进行性近端无力、吞咽困难和持续一个月的虚脱就诊。确认有严重肌肉受累，随后需要机械通气。初步研究显示肌酸磷酸激酶（CPK）显著升高>10 000 UI/L，肌肉活检显示肌纤维坏死和再生，伴有少量浸润，符合MNI。开始使用甲泼尼龙脉冲和丙种球蛋白进行强化治疗，随后加用甲氨蝶呤、硫唑嘌呤和利妥昔单抗。在这种联合方案下，患者表现出良好的进展，CPK逐渐下降，肌力功能恢复，吞咽困难改善，出院时可在最小辅助下行走。跨学科方法和早期实施强化免疫抑制对于逆转不利进展和优化这些患者的功能预后至关重要。

items.title: Hypomethylation of the Human OAS2 Gene in Blood Cells as a Potential Biomarker for Rheumatoid Arthritis: Findings from an Iranian Case-control Study.
items.abstract: Given the pivotal role of DNA methylation in the progression and severity of rheumatoid arthritis (RA), identifying a unique methylation pattern associated with the disease could support early detection, disease monitoring, and the development of personalized treatment plans. We aimed to explore the potential of OAS2 and OAS3 methylation levels in peripheral blood cells. These levels could be used to diagnose RA and predict patient outcomes. We collected 105 peripheral blood specimens from RA patients and 110 from healthy subjects. We then performed methylation analysis using the methylation-quantification of endonuclease-resistant DNA (MethyQESD) technique. Finally, we analyzed the data using appropriate nonparametric tests. Our study revealed a significant decrease in OAS2 gene methylation in RA patients ( P <0.001). The ROC curve analysis further underscored the potential of OAS2 DNA methylation (AUC=0.718, P <0.001) to effectively distinguish RA patients from healthy individuals. Although OAS2 methylation was generally reduced in RA patients compared to controls, RA patients with a positive family history exhibited higher methylation than those without ( P =0.018). Moreover, increased OAS2 methylation was associated with reduced CRP levels (r=-0.317, P <0.001). The methylation levels of OAS2 in peripheral blood cells show promise in distinguishing RA patients from healthy individuals. Furthermore, these levels show potential in identifying inflammation, a family history of RA, and other related disorders.

items.titleZh: 血细胞中人OAS2基因低甲基化作为类风湿关节炎潜在生物标志物：一项伊朗病例对照研究的发现
items.abstractZh: 鉴于DNA甲基化在类风湿关节炎（RA）进展和严重程度中的关键作用，识别与该疾病相关的独特甲基化模式可能有助于早期检测、疾病监测和个性化治疗方案的制定。我们旨在探讨外周血细胞中OAS2和OAS3甲基化水平的潜力。这些水平可用于诊断RA并预测患者结局。我们收集了105份RA患者和110份健康受试者的外周血标本。随后，我们使用甲基化定量核酸内切酶抗性DNA（MethyQESD）技术进行甲基化分析。最后，我们使用适当的非参数检验分析数据。我们的研究显示，RA患者中OAS2基因甲基化显著降低（P <0.001）。ROC曲线分析进一步强调了OAS2 DNA甲基化（AUC=0.718，P <0.001）有效区分RA患者与健康个体的潜力。尽管与对照组相比，RA患者中OAS2甲基化总体降低，但有阳性家族史的RA患者甲基化水平高于无家族史者（P =0.018）。此外，OAS2甲基化增加与CRP水平降低相关（r=-0.317，P <0.001）。外周血细胞中OAS2的甲基化水平在区分RA患者与健康个体方面显示出前景。此外，这些水平在识别炎症、RA家族史及其他相关疾病方面显示出潜力。

items.title: Microenvironment-Responsive Nanoparticles Enhance Rheumatoid Arthritis Treatment by Inducing Apoptosis in Inflammatory Macrophages and Fibroblast-like Synoviocytes.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a progressive autoimmune disease primarily characterized by persistent synovial inflammation and progressive bone erosion. Due to the complexity of its pathological microenvironment, pharmacological treatment of RA is often limited. This is primarily attributed to the fact that activated macrophages in the RA microenvironment secrete large amounts of pro-inflammatory cytokines, which further activate fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS), promoting a hypoxic synovial microenvironment and the release of inflammatory mediators. Inducing apoptosis in these inflammatory cells to mitigate inflammatory responses represents a potential therapeutic strategy for RA. Here, we developed microenvironment-responsive nanoparticles, ATKP-HA/CuS@Cel. Hyaluronic acid (HA) was first used to modify celastrol (Cel)-loaded octahedral copper sulfide nanoparticles (CuS NPs), forming HA/CuS@Cel NPs. Then, alendronate sodium (ALN), a potent osteoclast inhibitor, was conjugated to NH2-PEG-thioketal (TK)-COOH to obtain ALN-TK-PEG (ATKP). Self-assembly of ATKP onto HA/CuS@Cel resulted in the final ATKP-HA/CuS@Cel NPs. In vitro, this formulation enabled the release of Cel and ALN in response to reactive oxygen species, significantly inducing apoptosis of inflammatory macrophages and FLS. In vivo, ATKP-HA/CuS@Cel effectively accumulated at inflamed joint sites and markedly alleviated bone destruction and inflammatory responses in collagen-induced arthritis rats. Overall, our findings provided an innovative delivery strategy that enhanced RA therapeutic efficacy by inhibiting the abundance of various inflammatory cells through microenvironment-driven drug release.

items.titleZh: 微环境响应性纳米颗粒通过诱导炎性巨噬细胞和成纤维样滑膜细胞凋亡增强类风湿关节炎治疗
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种进行性自身免疫性疾病，主要特征为持续性滑膜炎症和进行性骨侵蚀。由于其病理微环境的复杂性，RA的药物治疗常受到限制。这主要归因于RA微环境中活化的巨噬细胞分泌大量促炎细胞因子，进一步激活成纤维样滑膜细胞（FLS），促进缺氧性滑膜微环境及炎症介质的释放。诱导这些炎性细胞凋亡以减轻炎症反应是RA的一种潜在治疗策略。在此，我们开发了微环境响应性纳米颗粒ATKP-HA/CuS@Cel。首先使用透明质酸（HA）修饰负载雷公藤红素（Cel）的八面体硫化铜纳米颗粒（CuS NPs），形成HA/CuS@Cel NPs。然后，将强效破骨细胞抑制剂阿仑膦酸钠（ALN）与NH2-PEG-硫缩酮（TK）-COOH偶联，获得ALN-TK-PEG（ATKP）。将ATKP自组装到HA/CuS@Cel上，最终得到ATKP-HA/CuS@Cel NPs。体外实验中，该制剂能够响应活性氧释放Cel和ALN，显著诱导炎性巨噬细胞和FLS凋亡。体内实验中，ATKP-HA/CuS@Cel有效富集于发炎关节部位，并显著减轻胶原诱导关节炎大鼠的骨破坏和炎症反应。总体而言，我们的研究提供了一种创新递送策略，通过微环境驱动的药物释放抑制多种炎性细胞的丰度，从而增强RA治疗效果。

items.title: Comparative Analysis of Contrast-Enhanced Ultrasound and Superb Microvascular Imaging in Rheumatoid Arthritis: Initial Findings of Second-Line Biologic-Resistant Patients.
items.abstract: Detection of synovitis is essential for assessing rheumatoid arthritis (RA) activity and changing the therapy. This study aims to explore the level of agreement and correlation between Disease Activity Score 28 calculated with C-reactive protein levels (DAS28-CRP) and contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) and Superb microvascular imaging (SMI) in the classification of disease severity index in patients with RA who did not respond to second-line biologic therapy. SMI and CEUS were applied to 37 patients with active RA does not respond to second-line biologic therapy. We evaluate the radiocarpal joint of both wrists. Differences in positive synovial vascularity (SV) and its semi-quantitative scale were observed, and the correlations of SMI and CEUS results with DAS-28. To obtain robust estimates and accurate confidence intervals, we conducted all analyses using nonparametric bootstrap methods. The results indicate that CEUS method shows fair agreement with DAS 28 clinical method (Kappa = 0.38), 95% CI (0.172, 0.547), p = 0.006, while SMI has weaker agreement (Kappa = 0.13) 95% CI (0.027, 0.246), p = 0.039. The correlation between CEUS and SMI is strong (ρ = 0.82), CI 95% (0.705, 0.879), suggesting that the two imaging modalities tend to produce similar classifications, although CEUS showed a stronger association with DAS28-CRP. Use of CEUS to detect vessels in the synovium and visualization of local SV is the method that most correlates with disease severity in relation to DAS 28 in patients with synovial arthritis who do not respond to second-line biologic therapy compared with SMI.

items.titleZh: 对比增强超声与超微血管成像在类风湿关节炎中的比较分析：二线生物制剂耐药患者的初步发现
items.abstractZh: 滑膜炎的检测对于评估类风湿关节炎（RA）活动性和调整治疗至关重要。本研究旨在探讨基于C反应蛋白水平计算的28关节疾病活动评分（DAS28-CRP）与对比增强超声（CEUS）和超微血管成像（SMI）在对二线生物制剂治疗无反应的RA患者疾病严重程度指数分类中的一致性和相关性。对37名活动性RA且对二线生物制剂治疗无反应的患者进行了SMI和CEUS检查。我们评估了双腕的桡腕关节。观察了阳性滑膜血管分布（SV）及其半定量量表的差异，以及SMI和CEUS结果与DAS-28的相关性。为获得稳健的估计和准确的置信区间，我们使用非参数自举方法进行了所有分析。结果表明，CEUS方法与DAS 28临床方法具有中等一致性（Kappa = 0.38），95% CI（0.172, 0.547），p = 0.006，而SMI的一致性较弱（Kappa = 0.13），95% CI（0.027, 0.246），p = 0.039。CEUS与SMI之间的相关性较强（ρ = 0.82），95% CI（0.705, 0.879），表明两种成像方式倾向于产生相似的分类，尽管CEUS与DAS28-CRP的关联更强。与SMI相比，使用CEUS检测滑膜中的血管和局部SV的可视化是与对二线生物制剂治疗无反应的滑膜关节炎患者中DAS 28相关的疾病严重程度最相关的方法。

items.title: Phoenixin-14 May Be a Potential Limiting Neuropeptide for Exaggerated Inflammation in Familial Mediterranean Fever and Periodic Fever, Aphthous Stomatitis, Pharyngitis and Cervical Adenitis Syndrome: A Comparative Study.
items.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate serum Phoenixin-14 (PNX-14) levels in Familial Mediterranean Fever (FMF) and Periodic Fever, Aphthous Stomatitis, Pharyngitis, and Cervical Adenitis (PFAPA) patients during both attack and attack-free periods to investigate its potential biomarker value. A total of 140 children were included in this cross-sectional study: 46 FMF, 48 PFAPA, and 46 healthy children. Blood samples were collected during both febrile and attack-free periods in the FMF and PFAPA patients, whereas samples from healthy controls were collected at a single time point. C-reactive protein (CRP), erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), serum amyloid A (SAA), fibrinogen, and serum PNX-14 levels were evaluated. Serum PNX-14 levels were measured using ELISA. SPSS 25 was used for statistical analyses. PNX-14 levels were significantly higher during attack periods in FMF and PFAPA patients compared to attack-free periods and healthy controls (p < 0.001). PNX-14 levels during attack-free periods were also higher in both patient groups than in healthy controls (p < 0.001). While a positive correlation was observed between PNX-14 levels and CRP (rho = 0.222, p = 0.04), no significant correlation was observed with ESR, SAA, or fibrinogen. No significant associations were observed between PNX-14 levels and disease severity (PRAS), colchicine treatment duration, or daily colchicine dose in the FMF group. PNX-14 may be part of a neuroimmune response aimed at resolving inflammation in autoinflammatory processes and could be a potential immunomodulatory biomarker. PNX-14 may be a complementary indicator reflecting inflammatory burden or the healing process.

items.titleZh: Phoenixin-14可能是家族性地中海热和周期性发热、阿弗他口炎、咽炎和宫颈腺炎综合征中过度炎症的潜在限制性神经肽：一项比较研究。
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估家族性地中海热（FMF）和周期性发热、阿弗他口炎、咽炎和宫颈腺炎（PFAPA）患者在发作期和无发作期的血清Phoenixin-14（PNX-14）水平，以探讨其潜在的生物标志物价值。本横断面研究共纳入140名儿童：46名FMF患者、48名PFAPA患者和46名健康儿童。在FMF和PFAPA患者的发热期和无发作期均采集血样，而健康对照组的样本仅在单一时间点采集。评估了C反应蛋白（CRP）、红细胞沉降率（ESR）、血清淀粉样蛋白A（SAA）、纤维蛋白原和血清PNX-14水平。使用ELISA测量血清PNX-14水平。使用SPSS 25进行统计分析。FMF和PFAPA患者在发作期的PNX-14水平显著高于无发作期和健康对照组（p < 0.001）。两个患者组在无发作期的PNX-14水平也高于健康对照组（p < 0.001）。虽然观察到PNX-14水平与CRP之间存在正相关（rho = 0.222，p = 0.04），但与ESR、SAA或纤维蛋白原未观察到显著相关性。在FMF组中，未观察到PNX-14水平与疾病严重程度（PRAS）、秋水仙碱治疗持续时间或每日秋水仙碱剂量之间存在显著关联。PNX-14可能是旨在解决自身炎症过程中炎症的神经免疫反应的一部分，并可能是一种潜在的免疫调节生物标志物。PNX-14可能是反映炎症负担或愈合过程的补充指标。

items.title: Multi-target Therapy with Rituximab plus Mycophenolate Mofetil versus Rituximab Monotherapy in Systemic Sclerosis-Associated Interstitial Lung Disease.
items.abstract: To compare the effectiveness and safety of rituximab (RTX) plus mycophenolate mofetil (MMF) versus RTX monotherapy in patients with SSc-ILD. We performed a retrospective comparative analysis among adults with radiologically confirmed SSc-ILD treated with rituximab monotherapy or RTX + MMF (MTT) as rituximab-based treatment strategy. The primary outcome was improvement in percent-predicted forced vital capacity (FVC%) of more than 5 percentage points at the end of 2 nd year (ΔFVC>+5). Secondary outcomes included longitudinal FVC trajectories over three years, skin involvement, and safety. Longitudinal analyses used linear mixed-effects models, with additional sensitivity analyses using inverse probability of treatment weighting. Among 109 patients (MTT n=42; RTX n=67), baseline FVC% was lower in MTT group (50.6 vs 61.0). At the end of two years ΔFVC>+5 occurred in 69% of patients receiving MTT compared with 33% receiving rituximab alone. Over 3 years, the adjusted mean increase in FVC% was greater in the MTT group than in the monotherapy group (+12.9% vs +4.4%) with early separation of lung-function trajectories that was sustained throughout follow-up. The association between MTT and greater FVC improvement remained consistent across prespecified subgroups, including patients with severe baseline restriction (FVC% <45%). Herpes zoster occurred more frequently in the MTT group, while serious infections were uncommon in both groups. In this real-world study, RTX plus MMF was associated with favourable longitudinal FVC% trajectories compared with RTX monotherapy in a non-randomised cohort, despite greater baseline disease severity in the MTT group. These findings support prospective evaluation of MTT particularly in high-risk patients.

items.titleZh: 利妥昔单抗联合吗替麦考酚酯多靶点治疗与利妥昔单抗单药治疗系统性硬化症相关间质性肺病的比较
items.abstractZh: 比较利妥昔单抗（RTX）联合吗替麦考酚酯（MMF）与RTX单药治疗在SSc-ILD患者中的有效性和安全性。我们对接受利妥昔单抗单药治疗或RTX+MMF（MTT）作为基于利妥昔单抗治疗策略的放射学确诊SSc-ILD成人患者进行了回顾性比较分析。主要结局是第2年末预测用力肺活量百分比（FVC%）改善超过5个百分点（ΔFVC>+5）。次要结局包括三年内的纵向FVC轨迹、皮肤受累和安全性。纵向分析使用线性混合效应模型，并使用治疗加权逆概率进行额外敏感性分析。在109例患者中（MTT组n=42；RTX组n=67），MTT组的基线FVC%较低（50.6 vs 61.0）。两年末，接受MTT的患者中69%出现ΔFVC>+5，而接受利妥昔单抗单药治疗的患者为33%。在3年内，MTT组的调整后平均FVC%增加大于单药治疗组（+12.9% vs +4.4%），肺功能轨迹早期分离并在整个随访期间持续。MTT与更大FVC改善之间的关联在预设亚组中保持一致，包括基线严重限制（FVC%<45%）的患者。MTT组带状疱疹发生更频繁，而两组严重感染均不常见。在这项真实世界研究中，在非随机队列中，尽管MTT组基线疾病严重程度更高，但RTX联合MMF与RTX单药治疗相比，与有利的纵向FVC%轨迹相关。这些发现支持在高危患者中尤其进行MTT的前瞻性评估。

items.title: Early life exposures association with later diagnosis of spondyloarthritis: A population-based case-control study.
items.abstract: To assess whether early-life antibiotics are associated with spondyloarthritis (SpA) diagnosed by age 21. In this population-based, matched case-control study, we used Danish live births (1997-2023) restricted to those reaching minimum relevant ages by December 31, 2024: 1-21 years for psoriatic arthritis (PsA), 6-21 years for peripheral/axial SpA and inflammatory bowel disease-associated arthritis (IBD-AA). Cases (n=560) had physician-recorded SpA (peripheral/axial SpA, PsA, or IBD-AA). Controls were matched 1:50 by birth year, sex, and calendar year of diagnosis. Primary exposure was systemic antibiotic use the first year of life; secondary exposures included antibiotic class, number of courses, delivery mode, early upper respiratory tract infection (URTI), and systemic nonbacterial antimicrobials. Conditional logistic regression estimated adjusted odds ratios (aORs); dose-response was tested with the Wald test. Among cases (median age 16.8 years; 59% peripheral/axial SpA, 28% PsA, 13% IBDAA), 50% received antibiotics, versus 42% of controls. First-year antibiotic exposure was associated with higher odds of SpA (aOR 1.35, 95% CI: 1.14-1.59). Broad-spectrum penicillins had the strongest class-specific association (aOR 1.42, 95% CI 1.19-1.70). Early URTI was independently associated with SpA (aOR 1.88, 95% CI 1.32-2.67); delivery mode and systemic nonbacterial antimicrobials were not. In SpA subgroup analysis, the association with first-year antibiotics was significant only for PsA (aOR 1.75, 95% CI: 1.27-2.41). Antibiotic exposure in the first year of life, particularly broad-spectrum penicillins, was associated with increased odds of SpA by age 21, supporting the hypothesis that early-life microbiome disruption may increase later SpA risk.

items.titleZh: 早期生活暴露与后来脊柱关节炎诊断的关联：一项基于人群的病例对照研究。
items.abstractZh: 旨在评估早期使用抗生素是否与21岁前诊断的脊柱关节炎（SpA）相关。在这项基于人群的匹配病例对照研究中，我们使用了丹麦活产婴儿（1997-2023年）的数据，仅限于截至2024年12月31日达到最低相关年龄者：银屑病关节炎（PsA）为1-21岁，外周/中轴型SpA和炎症性肠病相关关节炎（IBD-AA）为6-21岁。病例（n=560）有医生记录的SpA（外周/中轴型SpA、PsA或IBD-AA）。对照组按出生年份、性别和诊断日历年份以1:50的比例匹配。主要暴露是出生后第一年使用全身性抗生素；次要暴露包括抗生素类别、疗程数、分娩方式、早期上呼吸道感染（URTI）和全身性非细菌性抗菌药物。条件逻辑回归估计了调整后的比值比（aOR）；剂量反应关系采用Wald检验。在病例中（中位年龄16.8岁；59%为外周/中轴型SpA，28%为PsA，13%为IBDAA），50%接受了抗生素治疗，而对照组为42%。第一年抗生素暴露与SpA的较高几率相关（aOR 1.35，95% CI：1.14-1.59）。广谱青霉素的类别特异性关联最强（aOR 1.42，95% CI 1.19-1.70）。早期URTI与SpA独立相关（aOR 1.88，95% CI 1.32-2.67）；分娩方式和全身性非细菌性抗菌药物则无关联。在SpA亚组分析中，第一年抗生素暴露仅对PsA显著相关（aOR 1.75，95% CI：1.27-2.41）。出生后第一年抗生素暴露，尤其是广谱青霉素，与21岁前SpA的几率增加相关，支持了早期微生物组破坏可能增加后期SpA风险的假说。

items.title: Expanding the clinical spectrum of DNASE1L3-associated monogenic lupus: A case series of 4 syrian pediatric cases.
items.abstract: DNASE1L3 deficiency is a rare autosomal-recessive monogenic form of systemic lupus erythematosus, characterized by defective clearance of extracellular DNA, leading to immune-complex formation, autoantibody production, and systemic inflammation. While early-onset lupus nephritis and hypocomplementemic urticarial vasculitis are hallmark features, the full clinical spectrum remains incompletely understood, particularly in pediatric populations. We report 4 cases from 2 unrelated consanguineous Syrian families, including 1 genetically confirmed case with a pathogenic DNASEI L3 variant, 1 case harboring a homozygous DNASEI L3 variant of uncertain significance, and 2 phenotypically concordant siblings without genetic testing. Clinical, laboratory, and histopathologic data were reviewed to characterize disease manifestations, organ involvement, serologic profiles, and therapeutic outcomes. All patients presented with recurrent fever, cutaneous rash, and musculoskeletal involvement, with notable variability in autoantibody profiles, renal pathology, and disease severity. Genetic analysis identified a homozygous pathogenic DNASEI L3 variant in case 3 and a homozygous DNASEI L3 variant of uncertain significance in case 1, supporting a clinically suspected DNASEI L3-associated monogenic lupus-spectrum disease. Renal involvement ranged from IgA glomerulonephritis to class IV lupus nephritis. Ocular manifestations, including conjunctival congestion and papilledema, were observed in 3 patients, highlighting an underrecognized feature. Therapeutic responses varied: 1 patient remained stable on baricitinib, while 2 patients succumbed to severe neurologic or renal complications. This series underscores the heterogeneous phenotypic spectrum of DNASEI L3-associated disease, including atypical seronegative presentations and diverse renal pathology. DNASEI L3-associated disease should be considered in children with early-onset vasculitic rash, hypocomplementemia, and nephritis, regardless of classical autoantibody status. Our cases expand the known clinical spectrum, emphasize the potential for ocular involvement, and suggest a role for targeted therapies such as JAK inhibitors in interferon-driven disease. Early genetic testing is essential for timely diagnosis and management of this potentially life-threatening condition.

items.title: Misdiagnosis of Behcet's disease lung involvement as pulmonary cryptococcosis on imaging: A case report.
items.abstract: Behçet's disease (BD) is a systemic vasculitis that rarely involves the lungs. Pulmonary manifestations of BD can radiographically mimic infectious pneumonia, posing a substantial diagnostic challenge and increasing the risk of inappropriate treatment. This case report describes a young female patient with BD who presented with pulmonary opacities initially misdiagnosed as cryptococcal pneumonia based on imaging findings. A 28-year-old woman with a known history of BD presented with a 1-month history of fever, cough, and productive yellow sputum. She had been on long-term glucocorticoids, hydroxychloroquine, and colchicine for her underlying autoimmune disease. Chest computed tomography revealed bilateral consolidation and nodules with subsequent cavitation, initially suggestive of pulmonary cryptococcosis. However, extensive microbiological workup, including next-generation sequencing of blood and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, failed to identify any pathogen. Computed tomography pulmonary angiography demonstrated microthrombi and arteritis, leading to the final diagnosis of pulmonary vasculitis secondary to BD. The patient was treated with methylprednisolone, which was gradually tapered, alongside supportive care. Antifungal and antibacterial therapies were discontinued after negative microbiological results were confirmed. The patient showed dramatic clinical improvement, with resolution of fever and respiratory symptoms. Follow-up computed tomography demonstrated significant regression of consolidation and complete resolution of cavitary lesions. At discharge, her laboratory parameters had normalized, and she remained stable during 1-year follow-up. This case underscores that in BD patients, pulmonary opacities mimicking infection on imaging should not be automatically attributed to opportunistic pathogens. When empirical anti-infective therapy fails, and microbiological evidence remains negative within 72 hours, clinicians should promptly consider pulmonary vasculitis and pursue vascular imaging. Early recognition and timely initiation of immunosuppressive therapy can be lifesaving.

items.titleZh: 白塞病肺部受累在影像学上被误诊为肺隐球菌病：一例病例报告。
items.abstractZh: 白塞病（BD）是一种系统性血管炎，很少累及肺部。BD的肺部表现可在影像学上模拟感染性肺炎，构成重大的诊断挑战，并增加不当治疗的风险。本病例报告描述了一位年轻女性BD患者，其肺部阴影最初根据影像学发现被误诊为隐球菌性肺炎。一名有已知BD病史的28岁女性，出现为期1个月的发热、咳嗽和咳黄色脓痰。她因潜在自身免疫病长期服用糖皮质激素、羟氯喹和秋水仙碱。胸部计算机断层扫描显示双肺实变和结节，随后出现空洞，最初提示肺隐球菌病。然而，广泛的微生物学检查，包括血液和支气管肺泡灌洗液的下一代测序，未能鉴定出任何病原体。计算机断层扫描肺动脉造影显示微血栓和动脉炎，最终诊断为BD继发的肺血管炎。患者接受甲泼尼龙治疗，逐渐减量，并辅以支持治疗。在确认微生物学结果阴性后，抗真菌和抗菌治疗被停用。患者临床改善显著，发热和呼吸道症状消退。随访计算机断层扫描显示实变显著消退，空洞病变完全消失。出院时，她的实验室参数已恢复正常，并在1年随访期间保持稳定。本病例强调，在BD患者中，影像学上模拟感染的肺部阴影不应自动归因于机会性病原体。当经验性抗感染治疗失败，且72小时内微生物学证据仍为阴性时，临床医生应及时考虑肺血管炎并进行血管影像学检查。早期识别和及时启动免疫抑制治疗可能挽救生命。

items.title: Impact of etanercept on the progression of undifferentiated arthritis to rheumatoid arthritis: A prospective observational study in China.
items.abstract: This study explores the association between tumor necrosis factor (TNF) antagonist therapy and the progression from undifferentiated arthritis (UA) to rheumatoid arthritis (RA). This single-center prospective observational real-world study enrolled 70 patients with UA (baseline score ≥ 8) at Xingtai People's Hospital (May-December 2020). After propensity score matching (1:1), 64 patients were matched; 4 lost to follow-up were excluded, leaving 60 for final analysis. Patients received MTX monotherapy or etanercept + MTX. Between-group differences were assessed using the Mann-Whitney U test, chi-square test, or Fisher exact test. Survival was analyzed using Kaplan-Meier curves and log-rank tests, and independent prognostic factors were identified through multivariable Cox regression. A total of 60 patients (30 per group) were included in the final analysis. During the 3-year follow-up, patients in the etanercept + MTX group had a significantly lower risk of progression to RA compared with the MTX monotherapy group (6/30 [20.0%] vs 14/30 [46.7%]; log-rank P = .012). After adjusting for potential confounders, combination therapy remained independently associated with reduced progression risk (HR = 0.28, 95% CI: 0.10-0.83, P = .022). Clinical remission at 3 years was achieved in 25 of 30 patients (83.3%) in the combination group, compared to 17 of 30 (56.7%) in the monotherapy group (P = .024). In this exploratory real-world observational study, initial treatment with etanercept + MTX was associated with a lower observed risk of progression to RA and a higher observed rate of clinical remission than MTX monotherapy in high-risk UA patients. These findings should be considered hypothesis-generating and require confirmation in adequately powered randomized controlled trials in diverse populations.

items.titleZh: 依那西普对未分化关节炎进展为类风湿关节炎的影响：一项中国前瞻性观察性研究
items.abstractZh: 本研究探讨肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）拮抗剂治疗与未分化关节炎（UA）进展为类风湿关节炎（RA）之间的关联。这项单中心前瞻性观察性真实世界研究纳入了邢台市人民医院70例UA患者（基线评分≥8）（2020年5月至12月）。经倾向性评分匹配（1:1）后，64例患者匹配成功；排除4例失访者，最终60例纳入分析。患者接受甲氨蝶呤（MTX）单药治疗或依那西普+MTX治疗。组间差异采用Mann-Whitney U检验、卡方检验或Fisher精确检验评估。生存分析采用Kaplan-Meier曲线和对数秩检验，独立预后因素通过多变量Cox回归识别。最终分析共纳入60例患者（每组30例）。在3年随访期间，依那西普+MTX组患者进展为RA的风险显著低于MTX单药治疗组（6/30 [20.0%] vs 14/30 [46.7%]；对数秩P=0.012）。调整潜在混杂因素后，联合治疗仍与进展风险降低独立相关（HR=0.28，95% CI：0.10-0.83，P=0.022）。联合组30例患者中有25例（83.3%）在3年时达到临床缓解，而单药组30例中有17例（56.7%）（P=0.024）。在这项探索性真实世界观察性研究中，高危UA患者初始接受依那西普+MTX治疗与观察到的进展为RA的风险较低及临床缓解率较高相关，相较于MTX单药治疗。这些发现应视为产生假设，并需在不同人群中开展充分把握度的随机对照试验加以证实。

items.title: AdaBoost-based differential diagnosis of gouty arthritis and rheumatoid arthritis: model construction, temporal validation, and SHAP visualization.
items.abstract: The phenotypic overlap between gouty arthritis (GA) and Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) poses diagnostic challenges, particularly in resource-limited settings. This study aims to develop a robust, non-invasive machine learning (ML) framework based on routine hematological parameters to facilitate precise differential diagnosis and to evaluate its robustness in a temporally independent cohort. Adopting a temporal validation design, we retrospectively analyzed clinical data from a tertiary hospital. A development cohort (2021-2025; n = 9,903) was utilized for model construction, while an independent historical cohort (2015-2020; n = 1,983) served as an time-based internal validation set. Feature selection was performed via LASSO regression, followed by benchmarking nine ML algorithms, including AdaBoost. Performance was evaluated using the Area Under the Curve (AUC) and Decision Curve Analysis (DCA), with interpretability enhanced by the SHAP framework. Six pivotal features were identified, comprising demographics, traditional markers, and novel composite ratios (CHOL/TG). AdaBoost demonstrated superior performance, achieving an AUC of 0.898 in the internal test set and an impressive 0.897 in the time-based internal validation, indicating exceptional generalization. SHAP analysis revealed that beyond conventional markers, CHOL/TG is a key predictor, revealing a unique interaction pattern of lipid metabolism that distinguishes gouty arthritis (GA) from rheumatoid arthritis (RA). We successfully developed and validated an AdaBoost-based model leveraging routine blood indices for precise GA/RA differentiation. Validated across temporal cohorts, this cost-effective tool holds significant promise for optimizing early triage in primary care, while offering novel pathophysiological insights through the lens of lipid metabolism.

items.titleZh: 基于AdaBoost的痛风性关节炎与类风湿关节炎鉴别诊断：模型构建、时间验证及SHAP可视化
items.abstractZh: 痛风性关节炎（GA）与类风湿关节炎（RA）之间的表型重叠给诊断带来了挑战，尤其是在资源有限的环境中。本研究旨在开发一种基于常规血液学参数的稳健、非侵入性机器学习（ML）框架，以促进精确的鉴别诊断，并在时间独立的队列中评估其稳健性。采用时间验证设计，我们回顾性分析了来自一家三级医院的临床数据。开发队列（2021-2025年；n = 9,903）用于模型构建，而独立的既往队列（2015-2020年；n = 1,983）作为基于时间的内部验证集。通过LASSO回归进行特征选择，随后对包括AdaBoost在内的九种机器学习算法进行基准测试。使用曲线下面积（AUC）和决策曲线分析（DCA）评估性能，并通过SHAP框架增强可解释性。确定了六个关键特征，包括人口统计学特征、传统标志物和新型复合比值（CHOL/TG）。AdaBoost表现出优越的性能，在内部测试集中AUC达到0.898，在基于时间的内部验证中达到令人印象深刻的0.897，表明其具有出色的泛化能力。SHAP分析显示，除传统标志物外，CHOL/TG是一个关键预测因子，揭示了区分痛风性关节炎（GA）与类风湿关节炎（RA）的脂质代谢独特相互作用模式。我们成功开发并验证了基于AdaBoost的模型，利用常规血液指标进行GA/RA的精确区分。经过时间队列验证，这种经济有效的工具在优化初级保健中的早期分诊方面具有显著前景，同时通过脂质代谢的视角提供了新的病理生理学见解。

items.title: Splenic neuromodulation as monotherapy and in combination with biologic or targeted synthetic DMARDs for difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis (ConsiderRAte): a randomised, sham-controlled, early feasibility trial.
items.abstract: Preclinical and early human evidence indicate that splenic neuromodulation modulates immune activity either independently or in conjunction with biologic or targeted synthetic (b/ts) disease modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs). This study evaluated the safety, tolerability, and preliminary effectiveness of splenic nerve stimulation (SpNS) as monotherapy and in combination with b/tsDMARDs in adult patients with difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis. ConsideRAte was an early-feasibility, multicentre, randomised sham-controlled trial of an implantable device (Galvani System) delivering SpNS conducted across six centres in the USA and Netherlands. Adults with difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis, defined by inadequate response to at least two b/tsDMARDs, were implanted and randomised 1:1 to active (STIM ON) or sham (STIM OFF) stimulation following five sentinel patients. Participants received 12 weeks of stimulation in the monotherapy phase, defined as stimulation added to stable conventional synthetic DMARDS (csDMARDs) and/or low dose corticosteroids. Participants with Disease Activity Score using Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (DAS28-ESR) improvement of ≥1.2 continued stimulation for an additional 12 weeks; non-responders discontinued stimulation and received baricitinib for 12 weeks. Thereafter, participants who were not in remission could receive adjunct tsDMARDs (baricitinib) together with SpNS in an open-label phase for six months, after which the participants moved to long-term-follow-up. The primary objective was to assess safety and tolerability of the Galvani System, its implantation and subsequent stimulation; key secondary outcomes included assessment of disease activity Disease Activity Score using C-Reactive Protein (DAS28-CRP) and patient-reported outcomes. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05003310). Between January 2022 and November 2024, eleven participants (Five Open Label STIM ON, six randomised to STIM ON (n = 3) and STIM OFF (n = 3)) were successfully implanted with the Galvani System. No device-related serious adverse events, or unanticipated adverse device effects occurred. During the 12-week monotherapy phase, mean DAS28-CRP decreased by 1.02 ± 0.45 (mean ± Standard Error, [SE]) in the STIM ON group compared with -0.34 ± 0.14 in the STIM OFF group. Five of eight (62.5%) STIM ON participants achieved a clinically meaningful improvement (≥1.0-point reduction). Nine participants entered the adjunct phase, with mean (±SE) DAS28-CRP decreasing with -2.95 ± 0.56 points at week 12 and -2.28 ± 0.69 points at week 24; 55.6% (5/9) achieved low disease activity (LDA) and 33.3% (3/9) remission. Two participants remained on monotherapy. In exploratory analysis, biomarkers were assessed in the monotherapy phase at the end of 12 weeks and trends for systemic proinflammatory cytokine reductions and in TH17 (T-helper 17) cell populations were observed in responders as defined by DAS28-CRP changes. SpNS demonstrated a favourable safety profile and was well tolerated in this small cohort. Clinical improvements were observed for monotherapy, and enhanced outcomes were observed for adjunct treatment resulting in multiple participants reaching LDA or remission. By engaging neuro-immune pathways rather than targeting single cytokines, this approach represents a novel therapeutic option that warrants further evaluation as stand-alone therapy or to complement existing pharmacological treatments for difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis patients. Galvani Bioelectronics.
